metro_pop_prompts.name: metro-pop-board
metro_pop_prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished high fidelity desktop application screenshot for Flashheart, a local kanban tracking AI coding work. Landscape 1800x1150 or similar high resolution. Flat straight-on screen only, no device, no perspective, no surrounding presentation, no marketing hero. Usable dense desktop app with beautifully legible precise typography and carefully aligned spacing. Product navigation Board, Agents, Workstreams, Table. Left project rail All projects, Flashheart FH, demo DEM, sandbox FS, footer theme control and Local · Connected. Top right search, Needs you 1, Quit. Preserve metro metaphor meaning: saturated route colours identify WORKSTREAMS, never status. Route badges AR Agent runs blue, MP Agent protocol orange, BR Board refinement green. Status uses shapes plus words, type badges neutral muted tints. This is illustrative demo data, small 'Design study · Sample data' footer. No launch-agent buttons, accounts, avatars, analytics, charts or cloud.
Direction METRO POP: optimistic contemporary European transit identity. Warm ivory #F8F4E9 workspace, ink navy #142A43 typography, bold cobalt #234FDB masthead and cream left rail, big confident condensed sans signage headings with humanist body, orange primary New ticket, cobalt/orange/emerald workstream route lines and badges. Rounded 8px cards, crisp thin borders, tiny grounded shadows. Saturated colour planes in header and selected project but no random decoration. Beautiful editorial grid. Clearly different from generic SaaS.
Screen: Board selected, Flashheart. Toolbar New ticket, Filters, Colour by Type, Compact Normal Detailed. Five proper kanban columns Backlog, Up next, In progress, Ready to review, Done all visible. 8 convincing ticket cards with generous readable titles, IDs, route colour stripe and circular route badge, type tag, priority in words, criteria counts, unobtrusive timestamps. Include FH-3 'Verify a live hook session' backlog test AR, FH-5 'Codex support' Up next MP dependency 'Blocked by FH-4', FH-4 'MCP server and checkpoints' In progress MP 'Claude · Needs you' '4/8 criteria', FH-6 'Review panel and attachments' backlog MP, FH-7 'Agent-run follow-ups' review AR, FH-2 'Show runs live on the board' Done AR. Colourful but composed, empty spaces intentional. Route legend above board.

charcoal_edit.prompt: Edit this Flashheart Night Service UI mockup. Preserve the exact screen layout, content, typography, dimensions and component positioning. Replace ALL navy/dark-blue background and surface colours with absolutely neutral black and charcoal greys: app ground #101010, header and sidebar #090909, column wells #191919, raised cards and panels #242424, nested wells #1C1C1C, borders #383838. All neutral surfaces must have equal RGB channels with NO blue, navy, teal or purple cast, no blue ambient lighting and no gradients. Replace blue-grey secondary text with neutral light grey #B8B8B8, main text warm white #F2F0EA. Preserve saturated blue ONLY in small AR workstream badges, AR route lines and card stripes. Keep orange MP routes, green BR routes, vivid lime brand bolt and New ticket action. Replace blue selected navigation/control fills with charcoal and lime/white selection indicators. Selected project tile charcoal, project badges grey/white. Result should feel like beautifully crafted black metro signage with vivid route colours, rich neutral charcoal panels and excellent readable contrast. This is a precise palette revision, not a new layout.
